prediction_drift.interpretation: Prediction drift measures shifts in the distribution of model outputs. A detected drift indicates changing forecast scale/variance (e.g. seasonal ramp), but does not alone prove model performance degradation.

performance_monitoring.metric_scope_note: aggregate_volume_error_pct represents net volume discrepancy across the evaluated horizon. It is distinct from official mean weekly portfolio MAPE, where weekly errors do not cancel out.
performance_monitoring.interpretation: Actual forecast error measures real predictive performance against ground truth. Note: Net aggregate volume error across an entire multi-week horizon allows positive errors in some weeks to offset negative errors in others. Acceptance criteria must be judged against the official mean weekly portfolio MAPE (14.81% on development backtests), not aggregate window volume.
